_comment: Mirrors backend/db_scheme (Postgres schema 'profil'). Field and item names are column names; enums mirror the CHECK constraints and types (tests/test_profil_schema.py keeps them in sync). Every description defines period, unit and scope.

fields.name: deal_typ
fields.description: A01: type of the transaction: share_deal (purchase of shares, Anteilskauf) or asset_deal.

fields.name: kaeufer
fields.description: A01: buyer (Käufer/Erwerberin) of the transaction, full legal name.

fields.name: verkaeufer
fields.description: A01: seller(s) of the transaction with their shares, as stated (for example 'Max Muster (60 %), X GmbH (40 %)').

fields.name: signing_am
fields.description: A01: signing date of the purchase agreement (SPA, Beurkundung).

fields.name: closing_am
fields.description: A01: closing date (Vollzug) of the transaction.

fields.name: kaufpreis_eur
fields.description: A01: purchase price (Kaufpreis) of the transaction in EUR.

fields.name: locked_box_stichtag
fields.description: A01: locked box date (Locked-Box-Stichtag) of the purchase agreement.

fields.name: dd_art
fields.description: A02: whether the tax due diligence was done for the buyer (buy_side) or the seller (vendor).

fields.name: dd_umfang
fields.description: A02: scope of the tax due diligence report: full_scope or red_flag.

fields.name: dd_ersteller
fields.description: A02: firm that wrote the tax due diligence report.

fields.name: dd_report_am
fields.description: A02: date of the tax due diligence report.

fields.name: dd_datenraum_stichtag
fields.description: A02: data room cut-off date (Datenraum-Stichtag) the due diligence report is based on.

fields.name: dd_zeitraum_von
fields.description: A02: first year of the period covered by the tax due diligence (for example 2021).

fields.name: dd_zeitraum_bis
fields.description: A02: last year of the period covered by the tax due diligence (for example 2024).

fields.name: name
fields.description: A04: registered name of the target company (Zielgesellschaft) including legal form suffix.

fields.name: strasse
fields.description: A04: street and house number of the target company's registered address.

fields.name: plz
fields.description: A04: postal code of the target company's registered address.

fields.name: ort
fields.description: A04: city (Sitz) of the target company.

fields.name: land
fields.description: A04: country of the target company as ISO 3166 alpha-2 code (for example DE).

fields.name: registergericht
fields.description: A04: commercial register court of the target company (for example 'Amtsgericht Bremen').

fields.name: registernummer
fields.description: A04: commercial register number of the target company (for example 'HRB 31842 HB').

fields.name: rechtsform
fields.description: A05: current legal form of the target company as its usual abbreviation (GmbH, UG (haftungsbeschränkt), AG, KG, GmbH & Co. KG, SE), also when the document spells it out ('Gesellschaft mit beschränkter Haftung' is GmbH).

fields.name: rolle
fields.description: A06: role of the target company in its group: operativ (operating business), holding, immobilien (real estate), finanzierung, ip, erwerbsgesellschaft (acquisition vehicle).

fields.name: wz_code
fields.description: A07: main industry code WZ 2008 of the target company (for example '52.10').

fields.name: wz_bezeichnung
fields.description: A07: description of the industry code, including stated secondary activities.

fields.name: steuernummer
fields.description: Tax number (Steuernummer) of the target company as printed.

fields.name: finanzamt
fields.description: Tax office (Finanzamt) responsible for the target company.

fields.name: merkmal
fields.description: Yes/no/unknown facts about the target company. One entry per code the document makes a statement about. Codes: B04 KSt/GewSt-Organschaft exists (a draft profit transfer agreement is NOT an existing Organschaft), B05 USt-Organschaft exists, B07 foreign subsidiaries or permanent establishments, C04 open objections (Einsprüche) or lawsuits, C09 tax audit ordered or running, E01 loans from shareholders or related parties, E03 material rent, lease or leasing contracts, E05 real estate owned (Grundbesitz im Betriebsvermögen), E05b extended trade tax reduction (erweiterte Kürzung) claimed, E06 conversions or contributions (UmwStG) in the last 7 years, G02 tax-exempt sales (steuerfreie Ausgangsumsätze). Use unbekannt when the document raises the point but leaves it open; never answer nein just because the document is silent.

items.name: kurztext
items.description: One-sentence summary of the fact as stated.

fields.name: beteiligung
fields.description: B01: shareholders of the target company with their quota, current and past (one entry per shareholder and period).

items.name: sitz_wohnort
items.description: Seat or residence of the shareholder, with register number if stated.

items.name: anteile
items.description: Numbers of the shares held (laufende Nummern), as written.

items.name: gueltig_ab
items.description: Date from which the shareholding exists.

items.name: gueltig_bis
items.description: Date on which the shareholding ended; null if it still exists.

fields.name: anteilswechsel
fields.description: B02: changes of the shareholding of the target company in the last 10 years, including the current transaction.

items.name: mittelbar
items.description: True for an indirect change (mittelbarer Wechsel).

fields.name: organschaft
fields.description: B04/B05: tax groups (Organschaft) in which the target company is the controlled company (Organgesellschaft), existing, planned or ended. A draft agreement means status geplant.

items.name: art
items.description: kst_gewst for corporate/trade tax Organschaft, ust for VAT Organschaft.

items.name: vertrag_am
items.description: Date the profit transfer agreement was signed.

items.name: hr_eintragung_am
items.description: Date the agreement was entered in the commercial register.

items.name: wirksam_ab
items.description: Date from which the Organschaft is (or would be) effective.

items.name: bemerkung
items.description: Remark, for example that it is only a draft.

fields.name: auslandsbezug
fields.description: B07: foreign subsidiaries and permanent establishments of the target company.

items.name: land
items.description: Country as ISO 3166 alpha-2 code (for example NL).

items.name: status
items.description: ja if it exists, unbekannt if the existence is open (for example a possible permanent establishment under review).

fields.name: veranlagung
fields.description: C01-C03, C06: assessment status of the target company per year and tax type (one entry per year, tax type and kind of notice).

items.name: bescheidart
items.description: festsetzung (tax assessment), messbetrag (trade tax base amount), feststellung_14_5, anmeldung_168 (VAT return treated as assessment).

items.name: stand
items.description: Status: return not filed, filed, or assessed.

items.name: vorlaeufig_165
items.description: True when the assessment is provisional under § 165 AO.

items.name: vorlaeufig_az
items.description: Case number of the model proceeding the provisional point refers to (for example 'IV R 88/24').

items.name: abweichung_von_erklaerung
items.description: Deviation of the notice from the return, with amount.

items.name: erweiterte_kuerzung
items.description: Extended trade tax reduction (erweiterte Kürzung) for trade tax.

items.name: ablaufhemmung
items.description: Suspension of the statute of limitations.

items.name: verjaehrt
items.description: True when the year is time-barred.

fields.name: rechtsbehelf
fields.description: C04/C05: objections (Einsprüche) and lawsuits of the target company, including suspended proceedings tied to a model case.

items.name: ruht_rechtsgrundlage
items.description: Legal basis of the suspension (for example '§ 363 Abs. 2 S. 2 AO').

items.name: musterverfahren_gericht
items.description: Court of the model proceeding (for example BFH).

items.name: musterverfahren_az
items.description: Case number of the model proceeding (for example 'IV R 88/24').

items.name: veranlagung_steuerart
items.description: Tax type of the contested notice.

fields.name: aussenpruefung
fields.description: C07/C09: tax audits (Außenprüfung) of the target company: the last finished one and any ordered or running one.

fields.name: pruefungsfeststellung
fields.description: C08: findings (Feststellungen) of the last finished tax audit of the target company.

items.name: tz
items.description: Paragraph number of the finding (for example 'Tz. 1').

items.name: betrag_eur
items.description: Amount of the finding in EUR.

items.name: pruefung_zeitraum_von
items.description: First year of the audit the finding belongs to.

items.name: pruefung_zeitraum_bis
items.description: Last year of the audit the finding belongs to.

fields.name: steuerattribut
fields.description: D01, D02, D04: tax attributes of the target company: corporate tax loss carryforward, trade tax loss (Fehlbetrag), interest and EBITDA carryforward, per reporting date. Prefer the exact figure from a notice over rounded figures.

items.name: betrag_eur
items.description: Amount in EUR (0 when stated as zero).

items.name: festgestellt
items.description: True when a formal assessment notice (Feststellungsbescheid) exists.

fields.name: darlehen
fields.description: E01: loans to the target company from shareholders, related parties or group companies, current and repaid.

items.name: zinssatz_prozent
items.description: Interest rate in percent per year.

items.name: abgetreten_an
items.description: New creditor if the loan was assigned.

fields.name: nutzungsvertrag
fields.description: E03: material rent and leasing contracts where the target company is tenant or lessee.

items.name: nahestehend
items.description: True when the counterparty is a related party.

items.name: davon_unbeweglich
items.description: Part of the annual fee for immovable assets in EUR.

items.name: davon_beweglich
items.description: Part of the annual fee for movable assets in EUR.

fields.name: grundstueck
fields.description: E05: real estate used by the target company, owned or rented.

items.name: objekt
items.description: Name of the property or building.

fields.name: umwandlung
fields.description: E06: conversions and contributions under the UmwStG in the last 7 years where the target company is the receiving company, with blocking periods.

items.name: einbringungszeitpunkt
items.description: Effective date of the contribution or conversion.

items.name: sperrfrist_norm
items.description: Norm of the blocking period (for example '§ 22 Abs. 1 UmwStG').

items.name: ausgeloest_am
items.description: Date the blocking period was triggered.

fields.name: ust_steuerfrei
fields.description: G02: tax-exempt sales of the target company per year.

items.name: betrag_eur
items.description: Exempt sales of the year in EUR.

items.name: vorsteuerabzug_erhalten
items.description: True when input tax deduction is kept (vorsteuerunschädlich).

fields.name: finding
fields.description: K: risk register of the tax due diligence report (one entry per finding or Feststellung).

items.name: finding_code
items.description: Code K-n, where n is the number of the finding in the report (Feststellung 1 = K-1).

items.name: betrag_min_eur
items.description: Lower bound of the amount in EUR.

items.name: betrag_max_eur
items.description: Upper bound of the amount in EUR.

items.name: offene_rechtsfrage
items.description: True when it depends on an open legal question.

items.name: musterverfahren_az
items.description: Case number of a related model proceeding.

items.name: normen
items.description: Norms the finding refers to, from the allowed list.

fields.name: spa_absicherung
fields.description: K11: protections in the purchase agreement (SPA) for tax risks: indemnities, guarantees, purchase price, escrow, W&I insurance, covenants.

items.name: finding_code
items.description: Code K-n of the due diligence finding it covers, if stated.
